decided: 2026-10-23 - Khalid: block crawlers from my data at Cloudflare (and at S3), as long as it does not affect system operations and functionality
evidence: docs/audit/2026-10-23/aws-bill-oct22.md - Applebot rendered why.html ~6,000 times a day and pulled 10-30 GB/day of data files straight from S3; Googlebot did the same at ~0.5 GB/day
match: case-insensitive substring of the User-Agent header. Only self-declared crawlers are listed: never a generic word such as bot, crawler or spider, because the system's own clients use them (JustHodlBot/1.0, JustHodl-Bot/1.0, justhodl-tv-crawler/2.0).

applies_to.worker: cloudflare/workers/justhodl-data-proxy/src/crawler-gate.js refuses GET/HEAD for these tokens on every path except /, /health and /robots.txt (403, X-Robots-Tag noindex); POST/PUT/OPTIONS are never gated
applies_to.s3: bucket statement DenyAbusiveScrapersByUserAgent on justhodl-dashboard-live carries s3_tokens (crawlers that render JavaScript and so can reach the S3 URLs pages still use); applied by aws/ops/STAGED/ops_6628_crawler_gate_s3.py (the Worker half shipped in commit 14261948)
